# Fluffy Clouds

Fluffy Clouds is the blue, cloud-haired Pegasus stallion who helps bring winter to Ponyville in *My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic*. He's also the sensitive summit delegate who nearly ends a friendship over a stolen seat. Look for his curly white-blue mane and tail, green eyes, orange bow tie, and three-cloud cutie mark.

[![Fluffy Clouds (left) at the summit — Hasbro / DHX Media, Princess Spike](https://cdn.twibooru.org/img/view/2020/7/23/2018295__safe_derpibooru%2Bimport_screencap_fluffy%2Bclouds_galena_yuma%2Bspurs_big%2Bcat_gryphon_hybrid_pony_tiger_tiger%2Bgriffon_princess%2Bspike%2B%28episode%29_.png)](https://twibooru.org/2018295)

- **Name:** Fluffy Clouds is spoken in the show, not merely a fandom name. He is also identified as “Sad Delegate” in the *Princess Spike* credits, according to the [character reference](https://twitterponies.fandom.com/wiki/Fluffy_Clouds). Enterplay's [High Magic card #26](https://www.ccgcastle.com/product/my-little-pony/high-magic/fluffy-clouds-summit-delegate) uses Fluffy Clouds, Summit Delegate; Hasbro's [blind-bag merchandise](https://data.mlpmerch.com/blind-bag-cards/pony/fluffy-cloudsdale) uses Fluffy Cloudsdale.
- **Voice:** Speaking character, voiced in English by Trevor Devall, as listed in the [episode cast](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt4534306/fullcredits/).
- **Appearances:** Debuts in *Tanks for the Memories* (S5E5), returns in *Princess Spike* (S5E10), and makes a background appearance at Starlight Glimmer's graduation celebration in [Celestial Advice (S7E1)](https://www.equestriadaily.com/2017/04/celestial-advice-episode-followup.html). These are G4 television appearances.

## Important moments

- **The fluffy-cloud mix-up — Tanks for the Memories (S5E5).** Clear Skies mistakes a question about missing clouds for a question about Fluffy Clouds himself, completing the weather team's name joke while Rainbow Dash sabotages their work. [Episode transcript](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/Tanks_for_the_Memories); [full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RCoGgwErNQY) (timestamp unavailable).
- **Friendship over a seat — Princess Spike (S5E10).** He rejects Spike's advice until Spike attributes it to Twilight, then embraces forgiveness, helping Spike discover how easily he can exploit royal authority. [Episode transcript](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/Princess_Spike); [official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9UIV2iDij8Q) (timestamp unavailable).
